title: Ceramic Studio Membership
cost_text: $115/month with 4-hour volunteer commitment, or $175/month with no volunteer hours
summary: Monthly membership gives 24/7 studio access to electric and raku kilns, pottery wheels, and other ceramics equipment. Must be 18+ for unsupervised access.
how_to_join: Complete the Studio Membership Request form on the studio membership page and contact the studio for confirmation.
source_quote: Ceramic Studio Membership includes use of the following: Electric, & raku kilns
evidence_sentence: Membership page lists raku kiln access as part of the 24/7 studio membership benefits.
